status: Proposed vendor-neutral schema; approved business rules are explicitly identified.
editorial_default: BG-led content, structured blocks, separate localized records, full EN coverage, versioned release snapshot. No WordPress runtime or arbitrary page-builder HTML.

fields: publishedAt nullable ISO8601 UTC with recorded provenance; never a build clock
firstPublishedOnNewSiteAt nullable ISO8601 UTC assigned once on actual public activation
dateEvidence historical WordPress/public API values with confidence and source
PageLocale.gate: Published BG/EN releases have equal required section IDs/order/form schema and current translations. Drafts never fall back silently to another public language.
PageLocale.dateImport: Import each language-specific dates object from content-package.json. publishedAt/contentChangedAt/firstPublishedOnNewSiteAt map directly; status maps to dateStatus, policyId to datePolicyId, historicalEvidence to dateEvidence. The date status records provenance, independently of editorial publication status.
PageLocale.dateGate: Unknown legacy publication remains null. New pages receive actual successful first public activation time once. Existing publication is preserved. contentChangedAt is nullable before first publication and changes only for a substantive accepted public revision; JSON-LD and sitemap read that same persisted value.

Section.restriction: Only approved block types; no scripts/raw HTML embeds. Preserve existing page/route order unless specifically approved.

approved_turkey: Patras–Bari connection via Greece in both directions
blocked_facts: invented fares or direct Turkey–Italy sailing

ContactProfile.restriction: Mail recipients are server configuration, not public CMS/user input. Viber must not be marked verified before a real availability/deep-link check.

MediaAsset.restriction: Only sanitized public assets, no source SQL/backups/client data. Record meaningful text in route schedule images separately for BG/EN equivalence.

Navigation.restriction: Keep working route schedule links. UI deletion does not retire historical URLs.

Action.restriction: Internal destinations resolve by registry, never unchecked URLs. No javascript/data URL. No recipient selection from route context.

Enquiry.restriction: Private operational data, not public CMS content. No raw payload in analytics/logs.

NotificationOutbox.restriction: Persist atomically with enquiry. Email delivery is not a reservation confirmation. Ambiguous provider failures must not be called exactly-once.

RedirectDecision.gate: Pending retire/redirect rows are excluded from generated deployment rules.

Release.gate: No stale EN, missing media, unreviewed copy or unresolved required migration rule in a production release.

workflow: Editor drafts BG change with source/decision reference.
Shared section/field/fact changes mark EN stale.
Translator updates all affected text, image text/alt and messages; no fresh authorization needed for ordinary translation.
Reviewer checks copy, facts, BG/EN parity and route/action targets in protected preview.
Publisher approves a versioned paired content snapshot; publish webhook triggers signed CI job or explicit release.
Build validates snapshots; production stays on the prior accepted snapshot on failure.
Emergency rollback restores matching content + app + media + URL versions; do not overwrite newly accepted enquiries.

roles.editor: draft content and upload approved asset types

cms_proposal: Prefer a headless CMS backed by structured collections and revisioned exports. Directus is a candidate because official docs cover translation collections and content versions; exact license, pinned version, roles and approval controls must be verified in implementation. Keep this portable model if another CMS satisfies the same checks. Git-only JSON is not the default editor experience.
public_content_contract: Next server/build reads only approved release snapshots through a server-side CMS token or signed private object; CMS admin and draft APIs are not anonymously exposed.
it_preparation: DomainLocale model supports separate .it domain and translated slugs. Ownership/domain/content remain pending. No public /it fallback or empty IT sitemap/hreflang.
